source.document_title: საქართველოს მთავრობის 2014 წლის 15 იანვრის №58 დადგენილება — სასმელი წყლის ტექნიკური რეგლამენტის დამტკიცების შესახებ

scope.description: Natural or treated water used for drinking, food preparation and other domestic purposes, plus water intended for food or food-product production.
exclusions: Water for medical or other special purposes.
An individual private source supplying less than 10 m3/day to fewer than 50 people and not connected to a commercial or public network.
Natural mineral water with total mineralization above 1500 mg/L.

sampling_points.sampling_point: Inside the building, directly at the tap normally used for water consumption.
At the filling point and in the retail network.
At the water-supply points in food and food-product production facilities.

non_compliance_actions: Immediately investigate the cause of contamination.
Restrict the water supply where required.
Take other measures directed at protecting population health.

repeat_sampling.action: Collect a repeat sample; determine chlorides, nitrates and nitrites in the repeat-sample investigation as specified by the regulation.

emergency_monitoring.action: Apply an enhanced drinking-water quality control regime in coordination with competent state authorities.

independent_testing.requirement: Drinking-water testing must be performed in an accredited independent laboratory in accordance with the law.

transition_note: A 2026-06-24 amendment sets 2027-09-01 milestones for relevant methodology approval and groundwater nitrate-risk-zone identification. The transitional/repeal status of Decree №58/2014 after adoption of a replacement drinking-water regulation must be checked against the then-current consolidated law; this record does not assert a future in-force date.
interpretation_limits: These controls concern drinking water within the decree's stated scope; they are not automatically applicable to raw groundwater before intended use and matrix are confirmed.
The document is a legal control map, not evidence that any supplier performed the required sampling or response.
No actual sample counts, laboratory results, compliance findings or exposure estimates are included.
The current transition/repeal status after the 2027-09-01 milestones requires independent legal review before operational compliance use.
This structured record is a research aid only and must not be treated as legal advice or an authoritative compliance opinion.
Minimum sampling frequencies in Table 7 are regulatory requirements conditioned on population served and source type; they are not observed sample counts or proof of compliance.

sampling_frequency_requirements.process_parameters: Residual chlorine and residual ozone are monitored at least hourly; other treatment reagents are monitored at least once per shift.
sampling_frequency_requirements.special_case: For a groundwater distribution system supplying 20,000 people, microbiological and organoleptic samples are taken monthly.
